services.name: Admission
services.desc: Visitors are encouraged to purchase tickets in advance but may purchase tickets at the door. Tickets are nonrefundable. Blackhawk Museum is not a participating museum in the Museums for All program and does not accept EBT cards for discounted admission. We appreciate your understanding. If you have purchased General Admission tickets, the museum may be able to accommodate a one-time ticket transfer to change the date of your visit, pending ticket availability. To request a ticket transfer, please email info@blackhawkmuseum.org at least 48 hours in advance of your scheduled visit. Be sure to include your order number and an alternate date for your
